manifest.name: Helm
manifest.description: Helm releases: install, upgrade, roll back and uninstall, with chart repositories.

releases.title: Helm Releases
releases.emptyHint: Install a chart from a repository, an OCI registry or an uploaded archive.

release.upgradeUninstalled: An uninstalled release cannot be upgraded; roll it back first

chart.title: Chart
chart.deprecatedHint: The chart's maintainers have deprecated it

values.execRequired: Release values often hold credentials, so reading them needs the same permission as revealing a Secret.

compare.title: Compare values
compare.same: Revisions {{from}} and {{to}} have the same user-supplied values.

uninstallDialog.title: Uninstall release {{name}}?
uninstallDialog.message: Helm deletes the release and every Kubernetes resource it created in namespace {{namespace}}.
uninstallDialog.keepHistoryHint: The release stays listed as uninstalled and can be rolled back later.
uninstallDialog.doneKept: Release {{name}} uninstalled; its history was kept.

rollbackDialog.title: Roll back {{name}} to revision {{revision}}?
rollbackDialog.message: Helm creates a new revision from the chart and values of revision {{revision}}.

upgrade.title: Upgrade {{name}}
upgrade.reuseValuesHint: Merge the values below over the release's current values instead of replacing them
upgrade.noRepoChart: No added repository has the chart {{chart}}; the upgrade keeps the current chart.
upgrade.valuesReplaceHint: These values replace the release's current user-supplied values; an empty editor resets the release to the chart's defaults.
upgrade.valuesMergeHint: These values are merged over the release's current values.
upgrade.diffHint: Changes from revision {{from}} to revision {{to}}, from the dry run. Nothing has been changed yet.
upgrade.noChanges: The dry run renders the same manifest: the upgrade changes no resources.

repo.noResults: No chart of the added repositories matches.
repo.noRepos: No chart repository has been added yet.

oci.refHelp: An oci:// reference without a tag, e.g. oci://ghcr.io/stefanprodan/charts/podinfo
oci.versionHelp: Leave empty for the newest version

upload.hint: A packaged chart (.tgz, at most 20 MiB), e.g. from helm package or helm pull. It can be installed for 24 hours.

values.name: Release name
values.nameInvalid: Lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '.', at most 53 characters
values.namespaceNew: This namespace does not exist yet: create it below.
values.createNamespaceHint: Create the namespace if it does not exist
values.valuesHint: The chart's default values; change what you need. These values are stored with the release.

review.hint: The dry run of {{name}} in namespace {{namespace}} renders the manifest below. Nothing has been created yet.

repos.title: Helm Repositories
repos.emptyHint: An administrator adds the repositories charts are installed from; they are shared by every cluster.
repos.updateHint: Download every repository's index again (helm repo update)

add.title: Add a chart repository
add.description: KubeBench downloads the repository's index before adding it. Credentials are stored on the server and never shown again.
add.name: Name
add.nameInvalid: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', at most 64 characters
add.credentialsBoth: Give both a username and a password, or neither

removeDialog.title: Remove repository {{name}}?
removeDialog.message: Charts can no longer be installed from it. Installed releases are not affected.
